says: Every package a test mocks or the app imports, and where its real behaviour is met: runs (jest runs the package itself, never mocked here), test (a jest test runs the real package, by file and title), phone (a flow of the sealed E2E meets it on the emulator, by flow and what it meets), or judged (why no answer of it is read). `modules`: each module of the app the shared jest setup stands in for every test (the app's own road to an outside service), and where its real self runs. aLibraryIsKnownByMoreThanItsMock.guard.test.ts holds this file to the code.
